text:
Split for sequencing under EPIC P7. This bead keeps the infrastructure half (LICENSE, publishing metadata, -Werror, CI lane cleanup, publishLocal in the release gate) and should go early. The release half -- tagging 0.1.0 and proving the mima gate bites -- moved to P7.6, because P7.2 changes Vector[Byte] in public signatures across nine modules and a baseline published before it would be burned immediately.

Verified 2026-07-26: mimaPreviousArtifacts is Set() with zero git tags, so mimaReportBinaryIssues in CI currently checks nothing.
